name: ABBYY
label: ABBYY Cloud OCR / Vantage
description: ABBYY Cloud OCR / Vantage. Official API https://support.abbyy.com/hc/en-us/articles/360017269420-API-reference. One node; pick operation. Upload/download/convert/sign payloads use type file (Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.) Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. Commercial Cloud OCR. Partner/contract required. Public HTTP surface is Cloud OCR SDK API v2 JSON (/v2/processImage, /v2/processDocument, /v2/getTaskStatus); v1 XML paths without /v2/ are legacy. Vantage is tenant-specific REST. Files go to ABBYY cloud unless on-prem Vantage. Re-verify if Cloud OCR SDK is sunset for the customer's contract. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: process_image, process_document, get_task, get_result.

schema.label: language
schema.description: OCR language for process_image (English,French,…). Example: English.

schema.label: exportFormat
schema.description: process_image exportFormat. EXACT common: pdfSearchable | txt | rtf | docx | xlsx | xml.

schema.label: taskId
schema.description: Task id for process_document / get_task / get_result.

schema.label: task_id
schema.description: ABBYY task id (wire query taskId) for get_task, get_result, process_document.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: Password
configurationParameters.description: Cloud OCR SDK application password. StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Endpoint
configurationParameters.description: Cloud OCR processing location host. Official: cloud-eu.ocrsdk.com (EU) or cloud-westus.ocrsdk.com (US). No scheme.

configurationParameters.label: Task ID
configurationParameters.description: ABBYY task id (wire query taskId) for get_task, get_result, process_document.
